description: WattCoin: Browse the Skills Marketplace of community-built automation skills for WattOS, with optional search, category and sort. Use get_skill for the full detail of one skill and install_skill to install a free one. No auth needed; read-only and live. Returns a text list with name, version, author, price, install count, rating and category.

category.description: Category filter; omit for all categories

search.description: Search text matched against name, description and author (e.g. pdf)

sort.description: Sort order: newest (default), installs or rating

name: browse_marketplace
title: WattCoin: Browse skills marketplace
